source.original_question: Two flag posts are erected vertically. Find l, the length of the string (in metres) needed to join the tops of the two posts, correct to one decimal place.

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: The string joins heights differing18-13=5m with horizontal separation21m. Length=sqrt21²+5²=√466=21.587..., rounds21.6m.
